cobertura_format_evidence.group_identity: CoberturaReporter groups each source-line branch list by BranchInfo.Offset; condition.number is that IL offset. Method/class/source and canonical identical production DLL/PDB can identify a stable group.
cobertura_format_evidence.individual_path_identity: Not emitted. A condition gives only a truncated covered fraction for the whole offset group. Equal 50% does not show that the same path ran.
cobertura_format_evidence.group_type: Exporter labels entry.Value.Count > 2 as switch, otherwise jump. Thus a 50% jump necessarily represents one covered path out of two, but not which path.
cobertura_format_evidence.rate_precision: CoverageDetails.Percent = Math.Floor((Covered/Total)*10000)/100; Cobertura emits Percent/100. Safe package ratio intervals are [printed,printed+0.0001), expanded for floating-point arithmetic. They are not nearest-rounding intervals and are not exact counters.
cobertura_format_evidence.exact_global_counts: Root collector branches-covered/branches-valid are exact; class/method mapped line fractions are exact counts. Package nodes provide no exact covered/valid branch counters.

baseline_only_diagnostic.interpretation: These are baseline ambiguity counts, not measured loss or an actual before/after bound. If a matching head group remains50%, unknown path identity still permits one lost path. No branch capture or identity has been claimed.
